name: FleetFlow — Vehicle Fleet & Driver Log
description: A fleet and driver logbook for small fleets: track vehicles and drivers, log trips and fuel, schedule maintenance, and record incidents, with rego, insurance and licence expiry warnings. Includes 5 forms and 1 app.

packMeta.name: FleetFlow — Vehicle Fleet & Driver Log
packMeta.description: A fleet manager for small delivery fleets, trade crews, schools and community organisations: register vehicles and drivers, log trips with odometer and fuel, keep maintenance on schedule, and hold an incident register — all linked together.
packMeta.author: FormLogic

forms.title: Vehicle
forms.description: Register a vehicle with its rego, odometer and status, plus the rego and insurance expiry dates that drive compliance alerts.

fields.label: New Vehicle
fields.description: Add a vehicle to the fleet so its trips, maintenance and compliance dates all have a home.

forms.title: Driver
forms.description: Add a driver with contact details, licence class and the licence expiry date that drives renewal reminders.

fields.label: New Driver
fields.description: Add a driver to the roster so trips can be assigned and licence renewals tracked.

forms.title: Trip
forms.description: Log a trip against a vehicle and driver with odometer readings, purpose, destination and fuel cost.

fields.label: New Trip
fields.description: Record a trip so the odometer, fuel spend and vehicle usage all stay up to date.

properties.placeholder: Anything worth noting about this trip…

forms.title: Maintenance Job
forms.description: Book a service, repair or inspection against a vehicle with due date, status, supplier and cost.

fields.label: New Maintenance Job
fields.description: Schedule maintenance so services, repairs and inspections stay on time and on record.

forms.title: Incident
forms.description: Report a collision, near miss, damage, breakdown or fine against a vehicle and driver, with severity and status.

fields.label: Report an Incident
fields.description: Record what happened so the incident register stays complete and issues get followed up.

properties.placeholder: What happened, where, and who was involved…

apps.name: FleetFlow
apps.description: A fleet operations hub: register vehicles and drivers, log trips with odometer and fuel, keep maintenance on schedule and compliance current, and hold an incident register — all from one dashboard.

roles.name: Fleet Manager
roles.description: Full access to every FleetFlow form.

roles.name: Driver
roles.description: Drivers who log their own trips, view assigned vehicles and report incidents.

roles.name: Workshop
roles.description: Mechanics who manage maintenance jobs and review vehicles and incidents.

reports.name: Trips logged
reports.description: Total number of trips recorded across the fleet.

reports.name: Trips by purpose
reports.description: Count of trips broken down by their purpose.

reports.name: Fuel spend
reports.description: Total fuel cost summed across all trips.

reports.name: Trips by vehicle
reports.description: Count of trips grouped by the linked vehicle name.

reports.name: Maintenance by status
reports.description: Count of maintenance jobs broken down by their current status.

reports.name: Fleet logbook overview
reports.description: High-level summary of trip activity, fuel spend and maintenance across the fleet.

blocks.title: Fleet logbook overview
blocks.body: This report summarises trip activity, fuel spend and maintenance across the fleet. Use it to see how vehicles are being used, where fuel is going, and how the workshop is keeping up with scheduled and reactive maintenance.
